dashboard_field_meanings.limiting_criterion: Lowest standardized core criterion; not a causal SHAP explanation

dashboard_field_meanings.planning_review_needed: At least one provisional screening flag

dashboard_field_meanings.c3_building_context_raw_pct: Raw context only; excluded from reference scoring
dashboard_field_meanings.c5_elevation_raw_m: Raw elevation only; excluded from reference scoring
